title: What Is a Protein, Really? Explained Simply | PUC Biology Class 11
description:
A bowl of dal, your skin and bones, a green leaf in the sun: all packed with protein. Diya asks: what is a protein, really? And why must some of it come from food?

We grind a tissue in acid to split small micromolecules from the big biomacromolecules, zoom from a cell to a protein to one amino acid, build the average make-up of a cell step by step, and watch a protein chain being built from amino acids linked by peptide bonds. Then homopolymers vs heteropolymers, essential vs non-essential amino acids with a pause and think, the record holders collagen and RuBisCO, a worked example matching six proteins to their jobs, the lipid exam trap, an original NEET pattern question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

This is Episode 70 of our PUC Biology series.

Made for NCERT, CBSE, ISC (CISCE), PUC (Karnataka) and NEET students.

In this video:

2:15 Homopolymer vs heteropolymer
2:34 Essential amino acids + pause and think
3:14 Worked example: six proteins, six jobs
3:38 Exam trap: are lipids macromolecules?
4:02 Practice question (NEET pattern)
4:26 Recap and three questions to answer
